notes.summary: Luau 0.745; durable filesystem operations and authenticated ranged reads; optional script garbage collection; bounded nonblocking standard input; public userdata payload access; and faster typed data operations.
added: Durable filesystem creation, replacement, synchronization and retained-file operations, with recovery and failure handling across supported operating systems.
Authenticated ranged reads against a trusted file commitment, with bounded verification caches and native memory use.
An opt-in collectgarbage global for scripts, and a public host API for garbage collection.
Bounded nonblocking standard input consumers with host-controlled access and runtime shutdown cleanup.
Public userdata payload offset access for native lowering and shared-buffer integrations.
changed: Update the bundled Luau runtime to 0.745, including its native-code fixes and updated syntax support.
Improve typed data loops, overlapping span operations, contiguous-array kernels and native execution performance.
Require dream-net 1.1.1 and update the optional dream-soft-render integration to 2.0.0.
Raise the minimum supported Rust version to 1.95.
notes.migration:
Take 2.7.0 in place of 2.6.0.

The optional soft-render integration now uses dream-soft-render 2.0.0. Applications enabling that feature should check the renderer's 2.0.0 compatibility requirements.

The collectgarbage global remains opt-in. Standard input access remains controlled by host capabilities and policies.

Review any existing application-specific assumptions about filesystem durability and retained file handles before adopting the new APIs.
